title: Gambit screen navigation state diagram
description: Which screen the shell shows in front of the 3D table. Main._screen_name changes only in go(), which frees the old screen (a GameScreen closes its live connection and cancels Stockfish on the way out), stops the lobby's 10-second refresh, and shows the new one; go() also pushes onto a back stack of up to 12 entries that go("back") pops. The top bar is there from the start and stays on every screen, so its buttons lead from each state. go() waits for Api.load_me() before showing the lobby, contact or history. Continue with Google or GitHub leaves the page for icelander.net's sign-in (auth/login/{provider} redirects to the host's /auth/sign-in) and comes back as a fresh start; it is not a transition here. Desktop-only development switches (--goto and others) are left out.

states.description: No screen yet: the table turns behind the top bar while Api.load_me() finds out who is signed in.
The title, Play a friend, Play the computer, and Continue when a game against the computer is saved in play; the table turns slowly (showcase).
The computer's eight strengths and your colour; preloads Stockfish.
Signed in: invite by email, invitations both ways, games in play and contacts, refreshed every 10 seconds. Signed out: the sign-in card instead.
One contact: the record against them, every game together, invite, remove.
Finished games: from the server, 30 at a time, when signed in; from user://history.json when signed out.
A GameScreen (online, computer or replay) beside the board; no veil.
